newsitem.title: USA: Retirement Care buys Alabama facilities.
newsitem.headline: Retirement Care buys Alabama facilities.

text.p: Retirement Care Associates Inc said Monday it had acquired two assisted living facilities in Alabama and a nursing home in Florida.

The company, an owner and operator of retirement facilities and nursing homes in the southeastern United States, said it had acquired through leases the University Nursing Center, a 180-bed nursing home located in Gainesville, Florida, and a 48-unit assisted living and retirement facility in Hanceville, Alabama.
It said it also won a foreclosure sale of a 120-unit retirement and assisted living facility in Decatur, Alabama.
"These acquisitions will add more than $10 million in annual revenue and will expand our leadership position in the assisted living/retirement care market in the southeast," it said.
The company owns or operates 100 nursing homes, retirement centers and assisted living facilities with a total of more than 10,500 units.
